classes.definition: A portable computer with a screen and permanently attached hinged keyboard base visible as one device.
A handheld mobile phone, typically a slab-shaped smartphone or a feature phone, excluding tablets and cordless or desk landline handsets.
Over-ear or on-ear headphones with a headband joining two ear cups, including headsets with a boom microphone, excluding in-ear earbuds.
A wrist-worn electronic watch with a digital touch display, excluding analog watches, wall or desk clocks, and screenless fitness bands.
A standalone loudspeaker enclosure, including portable Bluetooth, smart, bookshelf, and computer speakers, excluding speakers built into another device.

non_class_outcomes.definition: The image is readable, but a candidate device or its target class cannot be resolved reliably.
The image is readable and contains no defensible instance of the five target classes.
Image quality, corruption, obstruction, or cropping prevents reliable target-instance annotation.
